name: Codspeed
description: CodSpeed is the all-in-one performance testing toolkit. Dive into benchmarking results, flamegraphs, and performance comparisons — give Claude granular profiling context to pinpoint bottlenecks and autonomously iterate on performance via the CodSpeed MCP server.
longDescription:
Ships **2 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (2): `codspeed-optimize` (Autonomously optimize code for performance using CodSpeed benchmarks, flamegraph analysis, and iterative improvement), `codspeed-setup-harness` (Set up performance benchmarks and CodSpeed harness for a project)
- **MCP servers** (1): `CodSpeed`

Installs with `claude plugin install codspeed@claude-plugins-official` from `CodSpeedHQ/codspeed`.
